verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five grasping aggregates.
The grasping aggregates of form, feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness.
These are the five grasping aggregates.

verses.pali: Imesaṁ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṁ upādānakkhandhānaṁ pahānāya …pe… ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā”ti.
verses.english: To give up these five grasping aggregates you should develop the four kinds of mindfulness meditation. …”
